decisions: Implement a separately named producer because existing cProfile would replace sys.setprofile; keep the original helper unchanged and never claim its producer hash.

Recognize exact native SQLite receivers and source/code/line metadata only. Preserve original MemoryBook/connection/cursor/row factories; no proxy, subclass, SQL trace, locals inspection or line tracing.
Keep raw nested C spans, exceptions, every callsite/category/query/cell and unknown buckets. Exclusive observed spans are partial attribution, not total SQL or uninstrumented speed.
Implicit cursor iteration remains unobserved and residual time explicitly unattributed; do not rewrite queries or iteration to make it measurable.
Retain calibration samples and callback bookkeeping separately, with no subtraction or best-of selection.
Use separate correctness and fresh measurement exports, one persistent worker, per-cell verified remote checkpoints, local per-query fsync and no replay.
implementation_requirements: Use a new publication namespace; do not import bound LM publish/prepare functions with globals that would target the completed LM result branch. Copy reviewed pure mechanisms or explicitly parameterize the new controller without mutating the old module.
Avoid source-path filesystem resolution or user-object access inside observation; classify known code metadata through precomputed maps and retain unknowns.

Before any corpus launch, commit exact observer/tests/workflow/binding, complete artificial protocol/native-guard tests, and obtain independent review of final code and identities. Root alone creates the unique trigger.
